analysis:
The PR only modifies CHANGELOG.md. Units 8 and 9 are the base tail and unit 10 is the head top. There is no executable, config or schema change, so no direct security regression is visible.

The head entries describe behavior changes whose code is not in this batch. These should be checked in the source diffs of the full PR.
- T-041 (SSD prefix cache, SEC-035): lines 5-8 add packed K4/V4 KV storage and packed historical checkpoints published at whole prefill frontiers. Lines 17 and 28-35 add demanded-prefix checkpoint retention, SSD write-share access for 'authenticated repeated checkpoints', cache storage controls (`cache set --directory`, external-volume UUID pinning, daily write ledger) and COMPLETE donation hashing bounded by the checkpoint. These touch the TB-007 at-rest artifact surface. Reviewers should confirm that HMAC lookup tags, cacheSalt scoping, the 30-minute TTL and the per-donation gate are unchanged. The checkpoint reuse and first-appearance write-share rules must not weaken account-scoped isolation.
- T-059 (erasure): lines 138-157 and 128-132 cover the admin erasure flow, a soft-delete mutation gate defaulting to false, and cohort/App Attest/APNs fencing. Verify that the code enforces the documented fences.
- T-060 (Autopilot floor, lines 43-62) and the machine-scoped Autopilot mode: confirm the admin endpoints sit behind TB-006 admin auth, and that live Autopilot control requires verified identity and consent.
- Line 164 documents that coordinator logs no longer carry PII. This relates to T-058, but the log text itself is outside this diff.
- Line 21 covers CI merge-clearance policy, a review-control path outside the runtime threat model.

The documented claims are consistent with the existing canonical entries. No threat-model contradiction is visible from the changelog alone.
